title: EnS-hAder
description: Pastel-themed shader pack. Works on Iris or OptiFine.
body:
# EnS-hAder

A pastel-themed, atmospheric shader pack for Minecraft. Compatible with **Iris** and **OptiFine**, and works on all Minecraft versions since it's built on GLSL 1.20.

## Features

- **Soft shadows** — smooth PCF-filtered shadow edges
- **Bloom** — soft light bleed on bright surfaces
- **Animated water** — wavy surface with specular highlights
- **Adjustable fog distance** — 4 to 16 chunks, changeable from the in-game shader options screen (⚙️)

## Installation

1. Install [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) or OptiFine
2. Download the ZIP from this page
3. Place it in your `.minecraft/shaderpacks/` folder
4. In-game: Video Settings → Shader Packs → select **EnS-hAder**

## Source

Full source code is available on https://github.com/thecrenss/EnS-hAder
